landing.metaTitle: Learn personal finance the clear way
landing.heroTitle: Learn to manage money while you are still in school
landing.heroBody: MoneyLab teaches personal finance to Vietnamese high-school students through short lessons and simulated situations, so you can practice decisions before real money is on the line.
landing.journeyCaption: From everyday spending to bigger decisions
landing.topicsBody: Each topic has short lessons, quick checks, and realistic scenarios.
landing.topic.budgetDesc: Plan spending and track monthly cash flow.
landing.topic.creditDesc: Accounts, cards, interest rates, and responsible borrowing.
landing.topic.taxDesc: Deductions to understand before your first employment contract.
landing.topic.scamDesc: Common tricks and how to protect your money.
landing.topic.investDesc: Risk, return, and first investing principles.
landing.topic.businessDesc: Capital, costs, and profit through a simple business model.
